# AI Usage in Envoy Products

Learn how Envoy uses AI to help power your workplace operations while protecting sensitive data.

August 31, 2026

Table of contents

[Overview](https://envoy.help/en/articles/16301838-ai-usage-in-envoy-products#h_d12a125be9)[Where AI is used in Envoy](https://envoy.help/en/articles/16301838-ai-usage-in-envoy-products#h_aaf7b0a8e5)[FAQ](https://envoy.help/en/articles/16301838-ai-usage-in-envoy-products#h_0e4598cc9b)

# Overview

AI is changing what software can do, and we think that's good news for the people who run workplaces. Since the workplace is a setting where trust matters more than novelty, we adopt AI where it meaningfully improves the product and hold it to the same standard as everything else we build.

- **Envoy does not use your data to train AI models.** Our [AI Terms](https://envoy.com/legal/ai-terms) contractually prohibit Envoy and our third-party AI providers from using your inputs or outputs to train or improve generative AI models.

- **You own your inputs and outputs.**

- **AI that involves a third-party provider is opt-in**, enabled by an admin.

- **Envoy does not train or fine-tune foundation models.** We integrate a small, security-reviewed set of third-party models.

- **People stay accountable.** Envoy's AI features _support_ human decision-making rather than replacing it.


# Where AI is used in Envoy

|     |     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Feature | What the AI does | Uses your data? | On by default? |
| Document parsing for **[Required document uploads](https://envoy.help/en/articles/14020000-pre-registration-document-uploads-for-visitors)** | Reads expiration dates off documents visitors upload during pre-registration, so admins don't have to type them in | **Yes** — the document you choose to collect is passed to the AI subprocessor | **No** — admin enables at the sign-in flow level |
| **[Threat intelligence](https://envoy.help/en/articles/15166385-threat-intelligence)** | Aggregates local news signals and scores incoming threat signals so only meaningful alerts reach your Threat Intelligence dashboard | **No** — it only reads public government and vetted local threat feeds. It has no access to your organization's data, visitor records, or employee information. | Included with Envoy Response |
| **[ID scanning](https://envoy.help/en/articles/3444461-id-scanning)** | AI-powered identity verification technology | **Yes** — the ID image is analyzed to check for fraud indicators. Amazon Rekognition is used for facial matching. | **No** — opt-in feature |
| **[Facial recognition](https://envoy.help/en/articles/8682063-facial-recognition-for-visitors)** for returning visitors | Recognizes a returning visitor to speed up sign-in | **Yes** — visitor photos, where you've enabled it | **No** — opt-in feature |
| **[Delivery name recognition](https://envoy.help/en/articles/3509710-about-delivery-recipient-name-recognition)** | Uses traditional OCR technology to read package labels | **Yes**, but Envoy's deliveries OCR is built in-house and does not use a third-party provider.\* | Included with Envoy Deliveries |

\*While traditional OCR technology is not widely considered to be "AI" by today's standards, it has been included in this article for transparency.

# FAQ

**Is my data used to train Anthropic's models, or any other AI provider's models?**

- No. Anthropic's Claude model processes it through Amazon Bedrock, which AWS runs in an environment isolated per model provider. Anthropic can't access that environment, and AWS doesn't share the underlying prompts or outputs with Anthropic.


**Which AI providers does Envoy use?**

- Anthropic powers document parsing and is listed as an optional subprocessor. Amazon Web Services (Rekognition) provides the image recognition behind returning-visitor detection and ID Scanning facial matching. Deliveries label reading was built in-house. Our current [subprocessor list](https://envoy.com/legal/subprocessors) is the authoritative source for third-party providers.


**Can I use Envoy without sending data to a third-party AI provider?**

- Yes. Every feature that sends your data to a third-party AI provider is opt-in. If you don't enable them, your data isn't sent to one.


**Who do I contact with more questions?**

- Reach out to your account team or contact Envoy Support. For security and privacy documentation, see [Envoy's security and privacy page](https://envoy.com/legal/security-and-privacy).
